beforeImage.name: Helax Istmo
beforeImage.description: Helax Istmo is a development-stage project intended to produce green hydrogen and green maritime fuels in southern Mexico. Its target end markets are shipping and other industrial users seeking lower-carbon fuel supply rather than retail electricity customers. The operating model is asset-heavy and pre-development in nature, with value tied to renewable generation, fuel-processing infrastructure, port and logistics integration, and future contracted offtake. Public announcements describe the project as part of Mexico's Interoceanic Corridor strategy and note that it is located in Oaxaca and remains in pre-development. Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners announced the project in late 2023 through its Growth Markets Fund II and Energy Transition Fund I strategies, and the current ownership percentages are not publicly disclosed.

afterImage.name: Helax Istmo
afterImage.subsector: Renewable power and green-fuels development (scope under review)
afterImage.description: Helax Istmo is a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners-owned development company for a large renewable-energy and industrial project in Oaxaca, Mexico. CIP's December 2023 disclosure identifies Helax as wholly owned collectively by CI Growth Markets Fund II and Copenhagen Infrastructure Energy Transition Fund I and describes a memorandum of understanding with Mexican authorities for an originally proposed renewable-power, green-hydrogen and green-maritime-fuels development. The individual fund split, entry date and committed project equity were not disclosed. CIP later said the project structure and scope remained under review, while public reporting indicated a possible redesign toward electricity generation. No current concession, final permit, offtake agreement, final investment decision, financing close, construction start or operating asset was verified. Helax remains one pre-development PortCo; CIIT, SEMAR, the Ciudad Ixtepec industrial site and any project facilities are counterparties or assets rather than separate owners. No sale, partner entry, exit or signed pending ownership transaction was found through August 19, 2026.
